title: 第4章 老树有问题！
slug: 史上第一祖师爷全本免费-史上第一祖师爷最新章节列表
content_zh:
躲在旁边的林锋无声的笑了起来：“稳妥的很！”
他捏了一个法诀，心中默念：“动！”意念控制下，他留在护符中的法力飞快运转起来。
早先埋藏在这里的九枚雷系灵力晶石，此刻也被引动，散发出强力的灵气波动。
“滋滋滋滋！”空气中阵阵刺耳电流声，一道道蓝紫色的电弧不停跳动着。
不等那小七反应过来，九枚雷系晶石同时迸射出九道雷光！
而他手中的护符就如同导向器一样，引得九道雷光一起向他激射而来，瞬间击破他的护体灵气。
“啊！！！”
伴随着惨叫声，九条电蛇缠绕在小七身上疯狂肆虐。
老陈大惊失色，连忙甩开老村长，冲上前来，双掌猛地一分一合，狂涌的法力扑到小七身上，试图驱散雷电。
对于老陈的举动，林锋视若不见，抬眼望向乌云密布雷声滚滚的天空：“今天是个好天气啊。”
他耸耸肩膀：“你们以为我的九天动雷引就那么简单？”
林锋双手法诀一变：“引！”
随着林锋手上法诀变化，缠绕在小七身上的雷电突然整齐跳动起来，充满诡异的韵律和节奏感。
下一刻，天空的云层中突然降下一道水桶般粗细的恐怖雷霆，目标正是地面上被雷电包围的老陈和小七！
这才是林锋九天动雷引神通的真正致命一击。
老陈见势不妙，不敢再管同伴，连忙向一旁闪开。
“不！”
小七绝望的望着犹如末日神罚般的雷霆当头劈下，他甚至都没来得及正式亮明自己的身份。
小不点和老村长震惊的望着那照亮天际的雷霆撕裂天空，他们完全想不到林锋看似随手送给小不点的护符竟有如此威力。
石村和狼村两个村子的村民更是目瞪口呆，以为是雷神显灵。

一切只在眨眼间。
雷霆落地，轰然巨响，强烈的闪光刺得所有人眼前白茫茫一片。
当他们重新恢复视力之后，急忙朝小七所处地方看去，原地赫然只有一片焦炭！
一个修真者，被这一道天雷炸得尸骨无存。
片刻之后，众人才回过神来，狼村村民瞬间炸锅，头也不回的四下逃窜，再没人敢留在原地同小不点他们为难，被老陈骨笛引来的凶兽也都被吓得四肢发软，全部夹着尾巴逃跑。
石村众人发出阵阵欢呼，老村长反应过来，重重一跺脚：“杀，今天在场的狼村人，一个不留！”石村村民士气高涨，一起追杀下去。
老陈呆了片刻，声嘶力竭的吼道：“我们是于家的人，你们这群乡巴佬敢杀我于氏家族的人，你们就不怕整个村子被夷为平地吗？”
新手礼包再次带来惊喜，林锋看着被雷劈过后焦黑的地面，沉默半晌，好半天之后才长出一口气：“还好，虽然使用起来限制太多太麻烦，但威力总算没让人失望。”
林锋摸了摸自己的鼻子，有了这一记九天动雷引做铺垫，他接下来再出场，折服老村长和小不点就容易得多了，毕竟在他们眼里，自己是仅凭那么一枚小小护符就折腾出这么大的动静。
要让林锋自己和老陈、小七两人正面交手，也能赢，毕竟他修习的九霄天雷正法，要远远胜过那两人修练的杂牌道法。
但绝没可能打出这么惊人的战果，那样一来，自己世外高人的伪装就被拆穿了。
哪能像现在这样，一击秒杀，轻松写意，挥挥衣袖，不带走一片云彩。
对于剩下没死的老陈，林锋没有放在心上，此人虽然躲开了雷击中心点，但受到波及后已经身受重伤，老村长和小不点足够收拾他了。
林锋现在准备悄无声息的溜进村长家的院子，坐在那里悠悠然的等老村长和小不点回来，更能展现他料事如神，安然自若的气度风采。
到时候还怕那小不点不纳头便拜？
对了，山宝出世时他为了便于野山林中穿行，把他那身道袍行头换下了，现在穿着一身粗布衣裳，看起来跟普通山民一样，要记着先把行头换回来。
“第一个徒弟终于要到手了。”林锋美滋滋的想着，转身向村口走去，抬头一看，脸上笑容顿时僵住，渐渐消失不见。
因为他分明看到，村口那一棵，原本应该全无生机，焦黑枯槁的老树枝干上，竟然抽出了一根新枝！
嫩枝上几朵粉红的桃花，鲜艳欲滴，摇曳生姿。

content_en:
Lin Feng, who was hiding next to him, laughed silently: "It's very safe!"
He made a magic formula and said silently in his mind: "Move!" Under the control of his thoughts, the magic power he left in the amulet began to circulate rapidly.
The nine thunder spiritual power crystals buried here earlier were also aroused at this moment, emitting powerful spiritual energy fluctuations.
"Zizzizizi!" There were harsh sounds of electricity in the air, and blue-purple arcs were beating constantly.
Before Xiao Qi could react, nine lightning crystals shot out at the same time!
The talisman in his hand was like a guide, causing nine rays of lightning to shoot towards him, instantly breaking through his protective aura.
"Ah!!!"
Accompanied by screams, nine electric snakes wrapped around Xiao Qi's body and wreaked havoc.
Old Chen was shocked and turned pale. He quickly threw away the old village chief and rushed forward. He opened and closed his palms violently, and rushed at Xiao Qi with a surge of mana, trying to dispel the thunder and lightning.
Lin Feng turned a blind eye to Lao Chen's actions and looked up at the sky filled with dark clouds: "Today is a good day."
He shrugged his shoulders: "Do you think my Nine Heavens Moving Thunder is that simple?"
Lin Feng's two-hand technique changed: "Lead!"
As Lin Feng's technique changed, the thunder and lightning wrapped around Xiao Qi's body suddenly began to beat neatly, full of strange rhythms and rhythms.
The next moment, a terrifying thunderbolt as thick as a bucket suddenly fell from the clouds in the sky. The target was Lao Chen and Xiaoqi who were surrounded by thunder and lightning on the ground!
This is the real fatal blow of Lin Feng's Jiutian Thunder and Divine Power.
Seeing that the situation was not good, Lao Chen did not dare to care about his companions anymore and quickly stepped aside.
"No!"
Xiao Qi watched in despair as the thunder struck his head like a doomsday divine punishment. He didn't even have time to formally reveal his identity.
The little one and the old village chief watched in shock as the thunder that illuminated the sky tore apart the sky. They had no idea that the amulet that Lin Feng seemed to give to the little one casually could be so powerful.
The villagers in Shicun and Langcun were even more stunned, thinking it was the God of Thunder appearing.
Everything happens in the blink of an eye.
The thunder struck the ground with a loud bang, and the strong flash of light blinded everyone's eyes.
When they regained their sight, they hurriedly looked towards the place where Xiao Qi was, and there was only a piece of charcoal in the place!
A cultivator was blown to pieces by this thunder.
After a while, everyone came back to their senses. The villagers of Wolf Village immediately went crazy and fled in all directions without looking back. No one dared to stay where they were and make trouble for the little ones. The ferocious beasts attracted by Old Chen Bone Flute were also frightened to the point where their limbs became weak and they all ran away with their tails between their legs.
Everyone in Shicun Village burst into cheers, and the old village chief reacted and stamped his feet: "Kill, no one from Wolf Village will be left alive today!" The villagers in Shicun Village were so high in morale that they chased him together.
Old Chen was stunned for a moment and shouted at the top of his lungs: "We are members of the Yu family. You country bumpkins dare to kill my Yu family members. Aren't you afraid that the entire village will be razed to the ground?"
The novice gift package once again brought surprises. Lin Feng looked at the charred ground after being struck by lightning. He was silent for a long time. After a long time, he breathed out: "Fortunately, although it is too restrictive and troublesome to use, the power does not disappoint."
Lin Feng touched his nose. With this Nine Heavens Moving Thunder as a foreshadowing, it would be much easier for him to convince the old village chief and the little boy when he appeared next. After all, in their eyes, he had made such a big splash with just such a small talisman.
Lin Feng could win in a head-to-head confrontation with Lao Chen and Xiao Qi. After all, the Nine Heavens Thunder Zhengfa he practiced was far better than the miscellaneous Taoism practiced by those two people.
But it is absolutely impossible to achieve such amazing results. In that case, his disguise as a worldly expert will be exposed.
How can it be like now, killing instantly with one blow, relaxing and freehand, waving your sleeves, and not taking away a cloud.
For the remainingLin Feng didn't take it seriously that Old Chen survived the attack. Although this man avoided the center of the lightning strike, he was seriously injured after being affected. The old village chief and the little boy were able to deal with him.
Lin Feng was now preparing to quietly sneak into the courtyard of the village chief's house, sit there and wait leisurely for the old village chief and the little boy to come back, which would better show his calm and calm demeanor.
Are you still afraid that the little one will bow before the time comes?
By the way, when Shan Bao was born, he changed out of his Taoist robes to make it easier to travel through the wild mountains and forests. Now he is wearing coarse cloth clothes and looks like an ordinary mountain man. He must remember to change his clothes back first.
"Finally we have our first apprentice." Lin Feng thought happily, turned and walked towards the entrance of the village. When he looked up, the smile on his face suddenly froze and gradually disappeared.
Because he clearly saw that the tree at the entrance of the village, which was supposed to be completely lifeless, had a new branch growing out of the charred and withered old branch!
A few pink peach blossoms on the twigs are bright and swaying.
